title: MCP CodeAgent Analysis
description: Interface-level analysis of a YunOS HDT or Android application, produced by /mcp-analyze. Captures capabilities, params, returns, safety levels, and error codes — NOT internal implementation details.

app.description: Application metadata extracted from manifest and source.

framework.description: Application framework detected from the imported source.

entryFile.description: Relative path to the main TypeScript, JavaScript, Kotlin, Java, or manifest entry file.

pages.description: Page names from the app manifest.

permissions.description: Declared permissions from the app manifest.

voiceEnabled.description: Whether the app has voice interaction enabled.

dualScreen.description: Whether the app supports dual-screen display.

deviceSources.description: Device-resolved variable names usable as ${__device__.X} in wires (resolved on-car, fail-closed if unset).

safetyProbes.description: Capability ids the safety guard calls to verify preconditions for p_gear_* tools. Declared explicitly per-app (no hardcoded probe ids). If a probe is omitted, the corresponding p_gear_* tools fail-closed (rejected).

gear.description: Capability id returning {isParked, ignoreMode} — gates p_gear_required / p_gear_and_confirm.

safetyRules.description: Custom safety rules (level → preconditions). Merged over the framework's 5 built-in levels, so apps can override a standard level or add custom ones (e.g. door_locked, speed_limited) without framework changes.

requiresGear.description: Check the gear probe (isParked) before allowing.

requiresHotspot.description: Check the hotspot probe (ssid != null) before allowing.

capabilities.description: Discrete capabilities exposed by the app. Each maps to one MCP tool.

id.description: Unique capability identifier in snake_case. Used as MCP tool name.

description.description: Optional description surfaced to upstream agents. Auto-derived from action/object/params/returns if omitted.

params.description: Input parameters accepted by this capability (each a $defs/paramDef). Object params declare `properties`, array params declare `items`; both nest recursively.

fields.description: Return fields — bare name (string, type unknown) or $defs/typedField. TypedField items/properties project to outputSchema, enabling tool chaining (e.g. read a resourceCode from query_*, feed it to install_*).

safetyLevel.description: Safety level determines precondition checks enforced by the middleware.

sdkCalls.description: YunOS SDK module paths called by this capability (e.g. '@system.router').

sourceRef.description: file:method reference in the original app source.

status.description: Authoring-confidence marker: verified (wire source-traced) | partial | broken (known no-op/bug).

enums.description: Enum types referenced by capability params or returns.

sourceFile.description: Source file where this enum is defined.

map.description: wireValue → human name map, projected as a reverse lookup export.

errorCodes.description: Domain-prefixed error codes. Key is the domain prefix identifier.

prefix.description: Domain prefix number (e.g. 2 for navigation → 2xxx error codes).

value.description: Suffix value. Full code = prefix * 1000 + value (e.g. 2001 = 2*1000 + 1).

paramDef.description: A named field — a capability param or an object-property field. Nested `properties`/`items` make object/array params project to structured JSON-Schema.

enum.description: Wire values — the upstream agent passes these verbatim, so they MUST be the real on-the-wire values extracted from source (NOT display names). schema_preview projects them directly into inputSchema.enum.

optional.description: Whether this field can be omitted.

description.description: Per-field description surfaced to upstream agents.

examples.description: Example wire values projected to JSON-Schema examples — strongest LLM steering signal.

minimum.description: Numeric lower bound (number fields) → JSON-Schema minimum.

maximum.description: Numeric upper bound (number fields) → JSON-Schema maximum.

defaultValue.description: Default value when omitted → JSON-Schema default.

properties.description: Structured object fields (when `type` names a model) → JSON-Schema `properties`. Each field is itself a paramDef, so nesting recurses.

items.description: Array element shape (when `type` is an array / ends in [] / Array<>). Projects to JSON-Schema `items`.

typedField.description: A named return field — narrower than paramDef (no enum/examples/defaultValue) but carries items/properties/required, so structured/array returns project to outputSchema for tool chaining.

description.description: Per-field description surfaced to upstream agents in outputSchema.

items.description: Array element shape (when `type` is an array). Projects to outputSchema items.

properties.description: Structured object fields (when `type` names a model). Recurses via paramDef.

required.description: Which of `properties` are required in the returned object.

fieldShape.description: A nameless recursive field shape — an array element (`items`) or nested sub-shape. Named fields (params, return fields, object properties) use paramDef/typedField.

enum.description: Wire values (same wire-truth rule as paramDef.enum).

description.description: Per-element description surfaced to upstream agents.

items.description: Element shape when this shape is itself an array (array-of-array).

properties.description: Structured object fields (when `type` names a model). Recurses via paramDef.
